name: Judgment Eluding Hauberk
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 17th; Weight 25 lbs; Price 50,250 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wearer of this +4 chain shirt can choose to pay 2 points from one random ability score as an immediate action to end one active smite effect based on alignment on herself, once per day.

Additionally, if the wearer is an invoker she may spend a full round action to sheathe herself in an arcane aura, she may dismiss this aura as a full round action. Any creature striking him with its body or a hand-held weapon deals normal damage, but at the same time the attacker takes 1d6 damage + 1 point of damage per die of the invokers mystic blast. This damage is of a type the invoker can deal with her mystic blast, and is selected when the invoker forms the aura. Creatures wielding melee weapons with reach are not subject to this damage if they attack him. While he is sheathed in this aura he may not use his mystic blast class feature.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells undetectable alignment, creator must have the mystic blast class feature; Cost 25,250 gp
